section: Accidental Deaths and Suicides in India 1980
title: 1.2 ## Accidental Deaths by Sex : Male victims of accidental deaths accounted for 65.2 percent of the total accidental deaths in the country during 1980. Femals victims were 34.8 percent. The ratio of male and female victims for the States as a whole was 65.0 and 35.0 respectively, while for the Union Territories as a whole it was 74.4 and 25.6 respectively. The percentage for the Metropolitan Cities taken together was 64.8 and 35.2 respectively.
